description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Junior Division at the 2025 World Championships, pairing Dragapult ex with Dusknoir. Dragapult ex's Phantom Dive spreads damage counters over the opponent's Bench, Dusknoir and Dusclops add more by Knocking themselves Out, Munkidori moves damage counters from its own side onto the opponent's, and Budew stops the opponent playing Item cards for a turn. The 2025 World Championships were held from 15 to 17 August 2025 at the Anaheim Convention Center in Anaheim, California, which had also hosted them in 2017.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2025 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
